scripts.minify:js: npx terser scripts/app.js -c -m -o scripts/app.min.js && npx terser scripts/auth.js -c -m -o scripts/auth.min.js && npx terser scripts/cart.js -c -m -o scripts/cart.min.js && npx terser scripts/product.js -c -m -o scripts/product.min.js && npx terser scripts/image-optimizer.js -c -m -o scripts/image-optimizer.min.js
scripts.minify:css: node -e "const CleanCSS = require('clean-css'); const fs = require('fs'); const files = ['styles/main.css', 'styles/product.css', 'styles/cart.css', 'styles/auth.css']; let combined = ''; files.forEach(f => { combined += fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8') + '\n'; }); const output = new CleanCSS().minify(combined).styles; fs.writeFileSync('styles/all.min.css', output);"
scripts.minify:all: npm run minify:js && npm run minify:css
